name: toronto
description: An accurate free-roam recreation of downtown Toronto, built from City of Toronto and OpenStreetMap open data and rendered by a hand-written WebGL2 engine with zero dependencies.

scripts.check: for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'all modules parse'
scripts.build:city: python3 tools/build_city.py && python3 tools/match_osm.py && python3 tools/attach_pois.py && python3 tools/pack_city.py
